accepted_scope: Exact ordered leaf map and arbitrary complementary data
Fourth power identity with the same projector and frame pair
Completed-frame conjugacy under the inherited leaf-frame hypothesis
Equal-frame k fractional and two magnitude bits
Odd direct-kernel k+1 fractional and two magnitude bits
Two encodes and two decodes with no intermediate full-owner scan
excluded_scope: Additional outer address maps or changing projectors
New finite primitive invoice or machine implementation
Global controller, owner admission, recursive supplier, or kappa improvement
